name: Dependency-factored robust regeneration
mixture_assignment: Index modulo 4 selects group; floor(index/4) modulo 3 selects attack severity. Original hidden worlds and candidate sets retained; one observation realization per world.
early_stopping: Mean of four validation group means of total loss, identical for every variant.
primary: JH minus ID macro regret across benign0 and targeted/random/coherent0.2, all facts64/budget2048/missing0.2
bootstrap: 2000 paired crossed seed/topology draws; same clusters across seeds and paired conditions
old_test_role: Seed32027 and its published results are development evidence for this second approach, not confirmatory evidence.
novelty_scope: Investigated composition of dependency-consistent probability regeneration, candidate supervision and smoothed group-risk training; Bayesian factorization and group robustness are established ideas.
budget_scope: New models regenerate all beliefs. ID is the fair full-reconstruction primary comparator; sparse P comparisons also change the repair budget.
wire_scope: All methods retain the same sparse report codec; no HDC wire-compression claim.
consistency_regularizer: Mean squared ReLU(child marginal minus parent marginal), identical for all new variants; zero for coherent conditional marginals.
